expectation: Cytoplasmic filaments in mesenchymal cells: fibroblasts, endothelium, smooth muscle and immune cells. Common in stroma, submucosa, villus/lamina propria cores and around vessels, and absent from epithelium. Expect fibrous networks with the epithelium left dark.
observed: A: bright fibrous network through the stroma, wall and villus cores; the blue epithelial lining is dark. B, C: scattered small rings inside the lamina propria, with the epithelial bands negative. D: perinuclear cytoplasmic rings and elongated fibrous cells, plus one round blob.
why: The stain is cytoplasmic and fibrous in stromal and mesenchymal cells, and the epithelium is clearly negative, which is the expected VIM pattern.
notes: VIM lights the stroma, the wall and the cores of the villi as a fibrous network, while the epithelial lining stays dark. Up close the cells show cytoplasmic rings and spindle shapes. The one round bright blob in D looks like an artefact and was not used for the verdict.
